two_engines.note: the engine fills at the next 1-minute open with its slippage model; dt.sim fills at the next 5-minute open with the same dollars as basis points; inside a bar both put the stop first

edge.note: NQ is one instrument. Fifteen years of 5-minute setups on it are a real test of the rules, not of any stock. Prices are the back-adjusted continuous series; fees and slippage are the engine's. Most people who day trade lose money.

overnight.note: Overnight = the Globex session from the prior 08:30-15:00 CT close to the 08:30 CT open, back-adjusted prices. orb15|r=1 outcomes use dt.sim at the 5-minute level with $22.24 a round turn (the engine's fees and default slippage on one contract) taken in R. Context, not a forecast.
